title: Buddy Johnson band players and touring
summary: Jazz players in the band, such as Haleen Rasheed and Purvis Henson, and a dance and theater touring life.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Within that band, besides Harold Minerve and Gil Askey, what other jazz players were there?

There was a trombone player that was playing lead. He was a Muslim, I remember. I can’t remember his name, but he played. He really played. He was a jazz player. And there was Purvis Henson, tenor saxophone player.

Yes. He played the trombone really well. There was a good band. They were playing a music that you could enjoy, even if you didn’t know that style of music. You could enjoy it, because they were playing good ensemble work. They had a good swing. They had a good drummer. It was really a good band.
What were the venues? What was the touring like of that band?
We were doing the dances, mainly dances.
Similar to what you did in the Hampton band.
Yeah, except they played more theaters than we did.
